rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gnupg2" ln -sf ../gnupg/gpg-preset-passphrase \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gnupg2/gpg-preset-passphrase" ln -sf ../gnupg/gpg-protect-tool \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/gnupg2/gpg-protect-tool"
ln -sf "gpg" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/gpg2" ln -sf "gpgv" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/gpgv2"
